Hi Alicia — looping in Ops (Camila) since the capacity uplift requires a short onboarding window.

Operational notes:
- To enable the +35% throughput, we need a scheduled change freeze window of ~45 minutes for model routing and capacity migration. Ideal dates: 11/14–11/16 (overnight maintenance windows) — which aligns with your requested 11/15 start.
- We'll provision a dedicated burst pool for the first 30 days to avoid throttling while billing and quotas settle.
- Required items from your side: confirmation of the primary IP allowlist and the preferred VPC peering window (if using Private deployment).

I'll prepare a short checklist (PO -> SOC2 link -> allowlist -> maintenance window confirmation) and post it in the procurement ticket so your team can check boxes.
